name: bilingual-arabic-cjk
summary: A trilingual notice: English, Arabic (right to left, joined letters) and Japanese, with a three-column glossary table. Fonts are bundled (Noto Naskh Arabic, Kosugi); nothing comes from the system.

name: certificate
summary: A landscape certificate: large centred type, a recipient line, two signature blocks.

name: contract-pdfa
summary: A services contract with numbered clauses and two signature blocks. lmpdf writes PDF/A-2b and PDF/UA-1 by default; the gallery caption shows the veraPDF result for this file.

name: invoice-multipage
summary: Invoice whose line-item table runs over several pages: the header row repeats on every page and the footer counts pages (Page X of Y). The rows are generated in the outer script as Markdown.

name: letterhead-footnotes
summary: A letter on a letterhead (running header) with numbered footnotes at the page bottom and a link.

name: newsletter-two-column
summary: A two-column newsletter: a section with two columns, headings, bullets and an image in the flow.

name: report-40-pages
summary: A 40-page technical report: a generated table of contents with real page numbers, numbered headings, a running header and a "Page X of Y" footer. The body is generated as Markdown.

name: resume
summary: A one-page resume: centred name, contact line, sections with right-aligned dates (tab stops) and bullets.
